frames.description: Frames to run after the script with no input.

perf.description: Measure each frame, and answer a summary of the times (`run` only).

perf_out.description:
Also write every kept frame's record there, a JSON line each; a
relative path is from the project's folder. It implies `perf`.

session.description:
Start from this session record, played to its end, in place of the
start options: the game's real start is the record's. A frame that
plays differently stops it there, and the script and `frames` don't
play.

start.description:
The game's own start options (`frame-png --help` lists them), in
the order given.

value.description: Its value, if it takes one.

SessionInput.description: A session record to play, in place of a game's start options.

any_stamp.description:
Play a record stamped by another build or with other content too
(`--any-stamp`), which is otherwise refused; it may then differ for
that reason alone.

file.description: The record's file, from the project's root.

Step.description: One step of a script, played in the order written.

oneOf.description:
Each whitespace-separated key chord pressed in one frame and let go
in the next, in turn (`"Enter Up Shift+Space"`).

Each whitespace-separated controller button pressed in one frame
and let go in the next, in turn (`"South"`; `"East+DpadDown"`:
those buttons together).

The game's action of that name (`Confirm`), pressed by the player's
primary key for it, or its primary button if it has no key.
That many seconds of frames with no input, 60 a second, rounded up.

The crank wound that many degrees in one frame (backwards is
negative), as a Playdate front end reports it.

Debug tools and the debug view's channels of these comma-separated
ids turned on from here on (`"grid,collision"`; `"all"` turns on
every channel, offered or not), and the frame drawn again: no frame
passes (ADR-0085). Played by the Harness only.
